samples.summary: Read-only cell-rectangle test cannot fail for the new write primitive it claims to pin
samples.evidence: The test's docblock says it pins that "the newest write primitive [Doc.applyInlineStyleToCells] is unreachable through the guarded API". But in read-only mode `view/editor.ts` replaces the whole `applyStyle` method with a bare noop (`MUTATING_METHODS` allowlist, editor.ts ~3641-3658), and `applyStyle` was already in that allowlist before this diff. So `editor.applyStyle({bold:true})` never reaches `applyStyleToCellRange`/`applyInlineStyleToCells` at all, and the assertion `stored.inlines[0].style.bold === undefined` holds regardless of whether the new cell-rectangle write path is correct — or even whether it exists. It only re-asserts a pre-existing noop stub.

samples.summary: Premise assertions use `.not.toBe(true)`, which passes for an empty/broken summary
samples.evidence: `expect(editor.getRangeStyleSummary().bold).not.toBe(true)` (line 167) and `expect(editor.getSelectionStyle().bold).not.toBe(true)` (line 176) pass when the value is `undefined` — i.e. also if `getRangeStyleSummary()` regressed to returning nothing at all, which is exactly one of the failure modes this PR fixes elsewhere (the empty header/footer summary). A positive assertion (`toBe(false)` / `toBe('mixed')`) would pin the intended value.

samples.summary: Test named 'same value at a collapsed caret as over the range' never establishes a range
samples.evidence: The test mounts a heading-6 text box, never selects anything, then compares `api.getRangeStyleSummary().italic` with `api.getSelectionStyle().italic`. With no selection, `getRangeStyleSummary` takes its collapsed-caret branch, so both calls run the identical `caretStyle(true)` code — the two values are equal by construction and no caret-vs-range agreement is exercised. It still catches the raw-vs-effective regression, but the comment ("the caret branch ... disagreed with the range branch") is not what is asserted.

samples.summary: No test covers the `isStyleOnInSelection` -> undefined fallback (range with no text runs)
samples.evidence: `text-editor.ts:2980-2991` returns `undefined` when the visited range yields no runs (`sawRun === false`), and `toggleStyle` then falls back to `effectiveVisual[key]`. The new suite only exercises collapsed carets (where `hasSelection()` is false) and ranges containing text; I found no test selecting across empty/placeholder blocks (zero-width inlines are skipped by `visitStyledRunsInRange`) to prove the fallback branch. Searched packages/docs/test for `isStyleOnInSelection`, `sawRun`, and read backward-selection-toggle.test.ts in full.

samples.summary: New model modules (range-slices/range-runs/caret-style) have no direct tests; defensive branches uncovered
samples.evidence: A repo-wide grep for `visitRangeSlices|visitCellRectangleSlices|dirtyBlockIdsForRange|caretInlineStyle|caretStyleDefaults|visitStyledRunsInRange|applyInlineStyleToCells` matches only src files, two editor tests and one model test — no test file targets `model/range-slices.ts` or `model/caret-style.ts`. In particular the newly added clamping of a stale/malformed cell rectangle (`range-slices.ts:51-59`), the `seen` cycle guard in `topLevelBlockId` (range-slices.ts:80-92), the `!cell` / `findIndex < 0` guards (lines 175-178) and the merged-away (`colSpan === 0`) skip in `visitCellRectangleSlices` are exercised by nothing I could find.

samples.summary: Caret-style resolution inside a table cell / header (findBlock instead of getBlock) is untested
samples.evidence: `TextEditor.getStyleAtCursor` previously used `this.doc.getBlock(...)` (body/header/footer top-level only, throws for cell-internal ids) and now routes through `caretInlineStyle` -> `doc.findBlock`, which also resolves table-cell blocks. That is a real behavior change for a collapsed caret inside a table cell (pending style, format-painter copy, toggle fallback). All new collapsed-caret tests (backward-selection-toggle.test.ts:315-362) use a body heading block; I found no test placing a collapsed caret inside a cell or header block and asserting the staged/read style.

samples.summary: Dirty-marking (`dirtyBlockIdsForRange`) correctness is only tested negatively
samples.evidence: The header-region tests (backward-selection-toggle.test.ts, 'style write inside a header region') assert only that no error is raised and that the store content changed; nothing asserts which blocks were marked dirty/repainted — e.g. that a style write inside a table cell marks the parent *table* block (the `topLevelBlockId` normalization) rather than the cell block. A wrong-but-non-throwing dirty set (stale paint) would pass every new test.

finding.summary: Text-box collapsed-caret font-size step: new raw-base / effective-size split has no test that can distinguish it
finding.evidence: `stepSelectionFontSize`'s no-selection branch was rewritten to read the *current* size from `caretStyle(true)` (named-style defaults layered in) while storing a *raw* `base` from `caretStyle(false)`. The only collapsed-caret step test is packages/docs/test/view/text-box-editor.test.ts:786, which uses a plain `paragraph` block whose run already carries `fontSize: 11` — raw and effective are identical there, so it passes with the old code too. The new describe block added by this diff (text-box-editor.test.ts:936-956, 'steps the font size from the named-style default') calls `selectAll()` first, exercising the *range* branch (`visitStyledRunsInRange`), not the collapsed-caret branch. Nothing asserts (a) a heading-6/heading-1 collapsed caret steps from 20 rather than the 11pt fallback, nor (b) the stated invariant that the staged pending style stays raw (no baked `fontSize`/`italic`/`color` from the named style) — the docs editor got that invariant test (backward-selection-toggle.test.ts:345) but the text box did not.

verdict.reason: The finding claims no test can distinguish the new raw-base/effective-size split in the collapsed-caret branch of stepSelectionFontSize for the text box. A direct counterexample exists: packages/docs/test/view/text-box-editor.test.ts:943-984 ('steps a collapsed caret from the named-style size and stages a raw base'). It mounts a heading-3 block with an unstyled run (heading-3 supplies fontSize 14 and color '#434343' per packages/docs/src/model/named-styles.ts:88), deliberately skips selectAll so the caret stays collapsed (line 964 comment) and the code takes the no-selection branch at packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:869-887. It asserts the stepped size is 15 (line 966) — a raw read would step the 11pt fallback to 12, so the assertion fails under the old behavior — and then types a character and asserts the committed run has fontSize 15 but color and italic undefined (lines 980-983), which is exactly the 'staged pending style stays raw' invariant the finding says is untested for the text box. The reviewer's cited lines 936-956 fall inside this test's doc comment and setup; the selectAll/range test they describe is the following one at line 986 (heading-1). Both halves of the claimed gap are therefore covered.
